planets.name: K2-292 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-292 with a 17-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: K2-292 b was found in 2019 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-292. Its orbit and size follow Luque et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
